body:
Please first open a discussion to seek approval for this API change; feature requests need approval there before an issue. The [Tables docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describe `Table.grid` as a layout tool for arranging renderables. A similar request was raised in #4171 and closed as not planned.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
